tokens.name: Metal_black
tokens.usage: Brand primitive (ink navy). Do not use directly in UI — reach for `ink`, `border` or `surface` (Night). Kept as the source value.

tokens.name: Metal_blue
tokens.usage: Brand primitive (deep blue). Graphics, menu selectors, shadows, inactive borders — via `accent`, `border-inactive`, `selector`.

tokens.name: light_orange
tokens.usage: Brand primitive (signal orange). Graphics, active menu selector, primary action fill — via `signal`. Never as text on white (1.99:1).

tokens.name: White
tokens.usage: Brand primitive. Page ground in Daylight and Sunlight via `surface`; text on `accent` fills via `on-accent`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on every platform. Night uses the brand navy itself.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, top and tab bars. In Daylight and Sunlight cards are separated by a `border`, not a grey fill.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, feed gutters, skeleton loaders. Sunlight drops the tint (tints wash out in glare) and leans on borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, headers and icons, on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `accent-soft`, `signal-soft` (≥14:1 every theme).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: timestamps, counts, hints — on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (≥8.6:1 Daylight, ≥14:1 Sunlight, ≥10:1 Night). Never lighter: no grey text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, secondary icons, selected text, chart lines — as text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `accent-soft` (≥7:1 Daylight and Sunlight, ≥6.1:1 Night).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active chip ground, info banners. `ink` or `accent` text on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (8.3:1 Daylight, 11:1 Sunlight, 8.8:1 Night).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active menu selector bar, unread dot, highlight graphics. A fill or mark — never text on `surface` in Daylight or Sunlight.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind a highlighted post or a warning notice; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `signal` fill (9.2:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Active / focused control borders, card outlines in Sunlight, header rules. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: border-inactive
tokens.usage: Resting input, chip and secondary-button borders (≥3:1 on every surface, so controls stay findable in glare).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between feed items and list rows — never the only cue that separates a control.

tokens.name: selector
tokens.usage: Active tab / menu indicator bar and selected-chip dot. Always paired with a weight or icon change, never colour alone.

tokens.name: selector-track
tokens.usage: Inactive menu indicator, progress track, inactive graphic strokes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid keyboard focus ring colour (≥3:1 on every surface). Use the `ring-focus` shadow.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions — always with an icon and a word. As text on `surface`/`surface-raised` (≥6.5:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations (service booked, part in stock, review posted) — always with an icon and a word. Blue-leaning so it is never told from `danger` by red/green hue alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal sheets and image text overlays.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Vazirmatn", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Your car, your mechanic, your parts
styles.usage: One per screen: onboarding, empty states, web hero.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Post titles, card headers, list primary lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Found OEM brake pads for my 206 in one search — 1,850,000 T, in stock.
styles.usage: Post text and all reading copy. 17px is the floor for reading text on phones.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; author names in a feed.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest permitted size: tab labels, badges. Never below 13px, never lighter than 600.

styles.name: fa-title
styles.usage: Persian screen and section titles. Taller leading than Latin for dots and descenders.

styles.name: fa-headline
styles.usage: Persian card headers and author names.

styles.name: fa-body
styles.sample: لنت ترمز اصلی Peugeot 206 را با یک جستجو پیدا کردم — موجود، ۱٬۸۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان
styles.usage: Persian post text. Same size as `body`, leading 1.75.

styles.name: fa-caption
styles.usage: Persian metadata. 1px larger than `caption`: Arabic-script dots need it.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use logical (start/end) properties for every horizontal value so layouts mirror in RTL.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside compact controls; gap between stacked lines in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between feed cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; web gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state breathing room.

radius.note: Rounded but not bubbly: soft enough to feel friendly, square enough to read as a tool.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small tags, input corners on web.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips (tall), images in posts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, the selector bar ends.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and the tab bar. Sunlight drops shadows: borders carry the shape.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, sheets, floating action button.

tokens.name: shadow-signal
tokens.usage: Flat offset shadow under the primary (signal) button — a crisp edge that survives glare and costs nothing to paint.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the ground colour, then a solid ring in `focus`.

size.note: Touch and icon sizes. Shared by iOS (pt), Android (dp) and web (px) at 1:1.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every control on every platform (above iOS 44pt — gloves, moving cars, sun).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact chips and secondary buttons; pad the hit area to `tap-min`.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size; 2px stroke.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and metadata lines.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatar in feed posts.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height (plus safe-area inset).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max reading width for web feed columns and articles.
